summary: 3-year-old went missing near the Eagle River at Dotsero, prompting a large multi-agency search (VMRG, Eagle County SO, FBI, HAATS, county SAR teams); his body was found in the Eagle River east of Dotsero on 2020-07-03; coroner ruled drowning, manner accidental.
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Parent-opened Real Vail article: child went missing June 5; body found Friday July 3 in the Eagle River just east of Dotsero; identified the following Wednesday; cause consistent with drowning, accidental. Search involved dozens of agencies (5th Judicial DA, Avon PD, CBI, CDOT, CPW, Colorado River Fire Rescue, CSP, Delta/Eagle/Garfield/Larimer County SAR, ECSO, FBI, HAATS, NCMEC, Northwest CO Incident Management Team, Routt County Communications, SCRG, Timberline Tours, Vail Fire/Police/Transit, Vail Mountain Rescue).
